name: AnionGap
title: Serum anion gap with albumin correction
description: Calculates the serum anion gap, optionally albumin-corrected, and classifies it. Version 4.

parameter.name: sodium
parameter.documentation: Serum sodium in mmol/L. Must be from 100 to 180.

parameter.name: chloride
parameter.documentation: Serum chloride in mmol/L. Must be from 60 to 140, and sodium must be greater than chloride.

parameter.name: bicarbonate
parameter.documentation: Serum bicarbonate in mmol/L. Must be from 2 to 60.

parameter.name: method
parameter.documentation: Gap method, a code of the value set http://example.org/fhir/ValueSet/anion-gap-method (code system http://example.org/fhir/CodeSystem/anion-gap-method): standard or with-potassium.

parameter.name: potassium
parameter.documentation: Serum potassium in mmol/L, from 1.0 to 10.0. Required when method is with-potassium; ignored in the computation when method is standard.

parameter.name: albumin
parameter.documentation: Serum albumin in g/dL, from 0.5 to 6.0. When given, the gap is albumin-corrected.

parameter.name: lactate
parameter.documentation: Blood lactate as a Quantity with system http://unitsofmeasure.org and code mmol/L or mg/dL (no other code). Its value in mmol/L (mg/dL divided by 9.008) must be from 0 to 30.

parameter.name: corrected-anion-gap
parameter.documentation: Albumin-corrected anion gap in mmol/L, 1 decimal. Present only when albumin is given.

parameter.name: adjusted-gap
parameter.documentation: Value the category is based on (corrected gap if present, else gap, minus lactate), in mmol/L, 1 decimal. Always present.

parameter.name: gap-category
parameter.documentation: low, normal or high. Always present.
